method: Web search results reviewed on 24 Oct 2026; pages not opened unless evidence says page.

timeline.title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) notified
timeline.detail: MSDE notified NAPS on 19 Aug 2016; government reimburses employers 25% of the prescribed apprentice stipend, capped at Rs 1,500 per month, plus basic-training cost up to Rs 7,500. Sources differ on whether it took effect on notification or 1 Oct 2016.

source.label: Vikaspedia, National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2016
timeline.detail: State reported investment proposals of about Rs 2.50 lakh crore, with manufacturing at Rs 1.61 lakh crore (January 2016 report).

source.label: Madhyamam, Investment summit got proposals worth Rs 2.50 lakh crore: Mamata

timeline.title: Closed North Bengal tea gardens and worker distress
timeline.detail: Duncans' closures from 2015 left about 25,000 workers unemployed in north Bengal; state paid Rs 1,500 per month subsistence to workers of five closed gardens (2016 reporting).

source.label: Organiser, North Bengal ground zero: agony of tea garden workers

timeline.title: Samsung announces Rs 4,915 crore Noida expansion
timeline.detail: Samsung announced Rs 4,915 crore to add capacity at its Noida plant under UP's Mega Policy.

source.label: Samsung Newsroom India, Samsung inaugurates world's largest mobile factory in India

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2017
timeline.detail: Third edition reported proposals of Rs 2,35,290 crore despite demonetisation.

source.label: Millennium Post, Bengal bags over Rs 2.35L cr investment proposals

timeline.title: UP Investors Summit 2018, Lucknow
timeline.detail: Summit on 21-22 Feb 2018 saw 1,045 MoUs worth Rs 4.28 lakh crore; Adani pledged Rs 35,000 crore and Reliance Jio Rs 10,000 crore; a Bundelkhand defence corridor was announced.
timeline.jobs_claimed: 33 lakh jobs claimed by CM (including further Rs 4 lakh crore in pipeline)

source.label: Invest UP, UP Investors Summit 2018

timeline.title: Samsung Noida mobile factory expansion inaugurated
timeline.detail: PM Modi and President Moon Jae-in opened the expanded Sector 81 plant (35 acres), raising capacity from 68 to 120 million phones a year, completed phase-wise by 2020.
timeline.jobs_claimed: 2,000 direct jobs per one source; 15,000 per another

source.label: Business Today, Samsung expands manufacturing facility in Noida; to produce 120 million units annually

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2018
timeline.detail: Commentary put fourth-edition intentions at Rs 2.19 lakh crore from 110 MoUs.

source.label: Asian Age, Biz-friendly Bengal: is Didi coming of age?

timeline.title: PLI scheme for large-scale electronics (mobile phones) launched
timeline.detail: MeitY introduced the Production Linked Incentive scheme for mobile phones under the National Policy on Electronics 2019, offering 4-6% incentive on incremental sales over base year FY2019-20. Outlay cited as Rs 40,951 crore; some later reports cite a revised Rs 38,601 crore.

source.label: India Law Offices, PLI scheme for manufacturing mobile phones in India

timeline.title: National Education Policy 2020 approved by Union Cabinet
timeline.detail: Cabinet approved NEP 2020 replacing the 1986 policy; official highlights say vocational education to start from Class 6 with internships and higher-education GER to rise to 50% by 2035. Sources date approval 29-30 July 2020.

source.label: Manorama Yearbook, New education policy gets cabinet nod

timeline.title: UP Electronics Manufacturing Policy 2020
timeline.detail: August 2020 policy extended electronics incentives beyond Noida, Greater Noida and the Yamuna Expressway zone to the whole state; projected Rs 40,000 crore benefits and 4 lakh direct jobs in five years. UP then reported about 60% of India's mobile and parts output.
timeline.jobs_claimed: 4 lakh direct jobs over five years (projection)

source.label: tele.net.in, UP government's new policy to incentivise electronics manufacturers lauded by ICEA

timeline.title: India Semiconductor Mission and Rs 76,000 crore semicon programme
timeline.detail: Government approved a Rs 76,000 crore outlay for semiconductor and display manufacturing under the India Semiconductor Mission; about ten projects with roughly Rs 1.6 lakh crore of commitments were later sanctioned. Approval date not shown in the result.

source.label: Deccan Herald, ICEA, GSA join hands to strengthen semiconductor ecosystem

timeline.title: UP Data Centre Policy 2021
timeline.detail: UP announced a data centre policy with land subsidies (25% in Noida/Greater Noida, 50% for Bundelkhand and Purvanchal); a 2026 analysis says all approved projects (Rs 21,343 crore, 644 MW) landed in Noida or Greater Noida.

source.label: w.media, India's largest state announces Data Center policy

timeline.title: Tajpur deep-sea port letter of intent to Adani
timeline.detail: CM handed the Tajpur port LoI to Adani Ports after bidding concluded in March 2021; the deal stalled through 2023-2025.

source.label: The Wire, Adani Group, Tajpur port and Bengal government's U-turn

timeline.title: Yotta D1 hyperscale data centre opens in Greater Noida
timeline.detail: Hiranandani Group's Yotta opened D1 (28.8 MW, about 5,000 racks, about Rs 1,500 crore) as north India's first hyperscale data centre, first of six planned buildings; Yotta signed an MoU to invest Rs 39,000 crore in 5-7 years.

source.label: DatacenterDynamics, Yotta launches data center in Noida, India

timeline.title: UP approves Rs 15,950 crore of data centre parks
timeline.detail: June 2022 reporting described state approval of four data centre park proposals worth over Rs 15,950 crore under the 2021 policy.

source.label: w.media, Uttar Pradesh Government approves proposals to set up Data Centres worth Rs 15,950 crore

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2022
timeline.detail: Sixth edition (April 2022) recorded proposals of Rs 3,42,375 crore with stated employment potential of 40 lakh.

source.label: EastMojo, Bengal received Rs 3.42 lakh cr investment proposals at biz summit: Mamata

timeline.title: UP Global Investors Summit 2023
timeline.detail: Summit on 10-12 Feb 2023 recorded about 18,643 MoUs worth Rs 33.50 lakh crore (other sources: Rs 32.92 lakh crore); renewables led at about Rs 3.58 lakh crore, ahead of electronics.

source.label: AffairsCloud, UP Global Investor Summit 2023: 18,643 MoUs Worth Rs 33.50 Lakh Crore Signed

timeline.title: Delhi-Mumbai Expressway first section opened
timeline.detail: PM inaugurated the 246 km Delhi-Dausa-Lalsot section built at Rs 12,150 crore, cutting Delhi-Jaipur travel to about 3.5 hours; full expressway 1,386 km.

source.label: Business Today, PM Modi inaugurates first section of Delhi-Mumbai Expressway

timeline.title: PMKVY 4.0 and Skill India Digital Hub
timeline.detail: PMKVY 4.0 (FY2022-26) runs the full enrolment-to-certification cycle through the Skill India Digital platform. Sources differ on launch year (2022 vs 2023).

source.label: CBSE Academic, Circular 122 of 2023 (PMKVY 4.0 / Skill Hub)

timeline.title: YEIDA Medical Device Park plot allotments
timeline.detail: By April 2023 YEIDA had allotted 59 plots (37 in phase 1, 22 in phase 2) in the 350-acre Sector 28 park; later reports cite 101 of 203 plots allotted and Rs 100 crore central support for a common facility centre.

source.label: Daily Guardian, YEIDA's medical device park picks up pace, over 100 plots allotted

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2023
timeline.detail: Seventh edition (November 2023) drew investment promises of Rs 3,76,288 crore.

source.label: Deccan Herald, Bengal govt's business summit draws investment promises worth Rs 3,76,288 crore

timeline.title: YEIDA International Film City awarded
timeline.detail: Bayview Projects (Boney Kapoor and Bhutani Group) won the Film City bid on 31 Jan 2024 with an 18% revenue share; concession signed 27 Jun 2024 for about 1,000 acres in Sector 21; estimated cost Rs 1,510 crore; phase 1 (230 acres, with a film institute) targeted by 2027.

source.label: Housing.com, Boney Kapoor's consortium signs pact with Yeida for Noida Film City

timeline.title: UP Ground Breaking Ceremony 4.0
timeline.detail: GBC 4.0 (19-21 Feb 2024, Lucknow) launched 14,537 projects worth Rs 10,15,583 crore from GIS 2023 MoUs; over 52% of projects in western UP.

source.label: Drishti IAS, Projects worth Rs 10 lakh crore to be implemented in Uttar Pradesh

timeline.title: AIIMS Kalyani dedicated to the nation
timeline.detail: PM virtually inaugurated the 960-bed AIIMS Kalyani (125 MBBS seats, 60 nursing seats, 30-bed AYUSH block) on 179.82 acres; OPD had run since 2019. One source gives cost Rs 1,754 crore (unverified).

source.label: BioSpectrum India, 5 AIIMS open at Rajkot, Bathinda, Raebareli, Kalyani and Mangalagiri

timeline.title: IndiaAI Mission approved
timeline.detail: Union Cabinet approved the IndiaAI Mission with an outlay of Rs 10,371.92 crore over five years, including compute capacity of over 10,000 GPUs, foundation models, datasets platform and sector applications.

source.label: TelecomTalk, Cabinet Approves IndiaAI Mission With an Outlay of Rs 10,371.92 Crore

timeline.title: Union Budget 2024-25 PM package for employment and skilling
timeline.detail: Budget announced a Rs 2 lakh crore central package for employment and skilling for 4.1 crore youth over five years, including a Rs 60,000 crore centrally sponsored scheme to train 20 lakh youth and upgrade 1,000 ITIs in hub-and-spoke mode.
timeline.jobs_claimed: opportunities for 4.1 crore youth over five years

source.label: PIB Ministry of Finance, Budget 2024-25 employment and skilling package

timeline.title: PM Internship Scheme pilot launched
timeline.detail: Announced in Budget 2024-25 to give one crore youth internships in top 500 companies over five years; pilot launched 3 Oct 2024 targeting 1.25 lakh internships, with Rs 800 crore for FY2024-25. Interns get Rs 5,000 per month plus Rs 6,000 one-time.
timeline.jobs_claimed: 1.25 lakh internships in pilot; 1 crore over five years

source.label: Amar Ujala, Prime Minister's Internship Scheme launched, to provide 1.25 lakh internship during FY 2024-25

timeline.title: Infosys New Town (Kolkata) campus inaugurated
timeline.detail: CM inaugurated Infosys' Rs 426 crore development centre on 50 acres in New Town, focused on cloud, AI and digital work.

source.label: Business Standard, Mamata Banerjee inaugurates Infosys development centre in Kolkata

timeline.title: UP Semiconductor Policy 2024
timeline.detail: UP notified a semiconductor policy (rolled out February 2024 per Swarajya) offering 50% additional capital subsidy over central support, 75% land rebate on first 200 acres for ATMP/OSAT and 10-year electricity duty exemption.

source.label: Invest UP, Uttar Pradesh Semiconductor Policy-2024

timeline.title: YEIDA semiconductor land: 225 acres for three companies
timeline.detail: UP approved three companies for semiconductor projects and allocated 225 acres in YEIDA Sectors 10 and 28 (2024 reporting).

source.label: Swarajya, Uttar Pradesh's first semiconductor park coming to Greater Noida

timeline.title: GlobalFoundries Kolkata Power Center
timeline.detail: After acquiring Tagore Technology's GaN power business, GlobalFoundries set up a design and test centre in Kolkata (STPI Salt Lake space allotted by the state); announced around the September 2024 Biden-Modi meeting.

source.label: Investment Monitor, GlobalFoundries to establish design centre in Kolkata, India

timeline.title: Bengal Global Business Summit 2025
timeline.detail: Eighth edition reported proposals of Rs 4,40,595 crore with 212 MoUs/LoIs (another source says 1,200+). State claimed Rs 13 lakh crore of Rs 19 lakh crore from seven earlier editions had been invested.

source.label: All India Radio News, BGBS 2025 secures over Rs 4.4 lakh crore in investment proposals

timeline.title: Parliament reply lists approved semiconductor units
timeline.detail: Rajya Sabha reply listed Micron ATMP Sanand (Rs 22,516 crore), Tata OSAT (Rs 27,120 crore), CG Power OSAT (Rs 7,584 crore), Kaynes OSAT (Rs 3,307 crore) and the Tata-PSMC Dholera fab (Rs 91,526 crore).

source.label: Rajya Sabha, Parliament Question 267 dated 07.02.2025

timeline.title: Mobile PLI payouts: 19 firms, record handset exports
timeline.detail: Report says 19 companies qualified for mobile PLI incentives with about Rs 8,700 crore disbursed over three years, fuelling a record surge in handset exports.

source.label: Vision IAS (Indian Express), The PLI push: $1 billion over 3 years to 19 firms

timeline.title: Microsoft India Development Centre campus groundbreaking, Noida Sector 145
timeline.detail: Microsoft broke ground for a 15-acre, 1.1 million sq ft IDC campus in Sector 145 planned as an AI, cloud and security hub.

source.label: Microsoft Source Asia, Groundbreaking ceremony for India Development Centre campus in Noida

timeline.title: Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) approved
timeline.detail: Cabinet approved ECMS with Rs 22,919 crore outlay over six years, expected to draw Rs 59,350 crore investment and Rs 4,56,500 crore production; part of the incentive is tied to employment targets.

source.label: Vision IAS (Indian Express), Cabinet clears Rs 23k-cr scheme for electronic components, targets 92k jobs

timeline.title: UP Global Capability Centres Policy approved
timeline.detail: State cabinet cleared the UP GCC Policy (titled 2024) on 6 May 2025 with payroll subsidies, internship and skill-building incentives, aiming to spread GCCs beyond Noida to Kanpur, Varanasi and others.
timeline.jobs_claimed: over 2 lakh high-paying jobs in five years (target)

source.label: Drishti IAS, Global Service Centre in UP (08 May 2025)

timeline.title: HCL-Foxconn OSAT near Jewar approved
timeline.detail: Union Cabinet approved the Rs 3,706 crore HCL-Foxconn display driver chip OSAT unit in YEIDA near Jewar airport (20,000 wafers/month, 36 million units/month), sixth ISM unit and first in UP; production expected 2027.

source.label: Tribune India, One more cap in India's semiconductor mission: new plant at Jewar, UP announced

timeline.title: Bagdogra Airport new terminal under construction
timeline.detail: AAI's Rs 1,560 crore expansion (terminal by Kalpataru Projects plus airside works) targets a 10-million-passenger terminal by March 2027; 13 bidders for apron and taxiway works in July 2025.

source.label: The Metro Rail Guy, 13 Bidders for Siliguri Bagdogra Airport's Apron and Taxiway Contract

timeline.title: IIIT Kalyani permanent campus near completion
timeline.detail: Lok Sabha answer (August 2025) put the permanent campus on the Kalyani Expressway at 98% physical progress; the institute still runs from the Webel IT Park building in Kalyani.

source.label: Careers360, IIIT Kalyani campus 98% complete; 28 new faculty positions

timeline.title: Union Budget 2026-27 skilling measures
timeline.detail: Coverage reports MSDE allocation raised from Rs 6,100 crore to Rs 9,885.80 crore, a scheme to train 1.5 lakh geriatric and allied caregivers over five years, and AVGC content creator labs in 15,000 schools and 500 colleges. Figures are from secondary coverage.

source.label: National Skills Network, Budget 2026-27 highlights: skill and education

timeline.title: Change of state government in West Bengal
timeline.detail: BJP won the April 2026 election (results 4 May); Suvendu Adhikari sworn in as chief minister on 9 May 2026, ending TMC rule.

source.label: The Quint, Suvendu Adhikari sworn in as West Bengal's first BJP chief minister

timeline.title: Noida International Airport (Jewar) starts commercial flights
timeline.detail: Commercial operations began on 15 Jun 2026 with an IndiGo flight; phase 1 has one runway and one terminal for up to 12 million passengers a year. Sources differ on formal inauguration date.

source.label: All India Radio News, Noida International Airport in Jewar begins commercial flight operations

timeline.title: West Bengal Budget 2026-27 (first BJP budget)
timeline.detail: Budget proposed single-window clearance, an AI mission and semiconductor hub, Rs 200 crore to make Siliguri a logistics and trade hub, a 50,000 sq ft Siliguri IT park and Rs 1,821.52 crore for North Bengal development.

source.label: The Week, West Bengal Budget 2026-27: Viksit Bangla

timeline.title: Maruti Suzuki Kharkhoda (Haryana) plant inaugurated
timeline.detail: PM Modi and Japan PM Takaichi virtually inaugurated the Rs 35,000 crore Kharkhoda plant; two units running at 2.5 lakh vehicles each, planned 10 lakh vehicles on 800 acres with supplier park.

source.label: Outlook Business, Modi, Takaichi inaugurate Maruti Suzuki's Rs 35,000 cr Kharkhoda manufacturing plant

timeline.title: Review of closed North Bengal tea gardens
timeline.detail: Labour Minister Arjun Singh met unions and managements at Uttarkanya, Siliguri, on wages, bonus, gratuity and PF dues in shut gardens; CM stated commitment to revive closed gardens.

source.label: All India Radio News, West Bengal Labour Minister holds meeting at Uttarkanya secretariat

timeline.title: Land identification for Kalyani greenfield airport
timeline.detail: State began identifying about 2,000 acres across nine mouzas in Nadia including Kalyani and restricted land registrations; it already owns about 240 acres.

source.label: All India Radio News, West Bengal govt begins process of identifying land for proposed Kalyani greenfield airport

timeline.title: Land allotted for 33 industrial projects
timeline.detail: CM said land allotment was complete for 33 projects with about Rs 60,000 crore proposed investment in semiconductors, defence, solar, EVs, pharma, steel, food processing, textiles, engineering and MSME. Locations not named.

source.label: Indian Masterminds, West Bengal industrial land allotment

timeline.title: PMKVY 4.0 reported at about 15% of target
timeline.detail: Careers360 (March 2026) reports PMKVY 4.0 certified only about 15% of its three-year target and MSDE is preparing PMKVY 5.0 with skill vouchers, outcome bonds and APAAR ID linkage.

source.label: Careers360, PMKVY 4.0 meets just 15% of target, MSDE plans version 5.0

timeline.title: Dixon display module fab in Noida-Greater Noida
timeline.detail: Dixon will invest about Rs 1,100 crore in a display facility approved under ECMS, with eventual capacity of about 6 crore mobile and 2.4 crore IT hardware display units a year; trial production expected around July.

source.label: Communications Today, Dixon Technologies to invest Rs 1,100 crore in Noida display fab

timeline.title: UP Data Centre Policy 2026 unveiled
timeline.detail: UP's IT minister unveiled a Data Centre Policy 2026 in July, reviving the 50% land subsidy for Bundelkhand and Purvanchal; the 2021 policy had approved Rs 21,343 crore (644 MW), all in Noida or Greater Noida.

source.label: Swarajya, UP is offering cheap land to two regions that cannot host a data centre

timeline.title: TVS ILP logistics park MoU in Siliguri
timeline.detail: TVS Industrial and Logistics Parks signed an MoU (May 2026) for a 10-acre Grade A logistics park in Siliguri with Ram Niwas Group.

source.label: Outlook Business, TVS Industrial & Logistics Parks to set up logistics park in Siliguri

timeline.title: Tajpur port re-tendered and relocated
timeline.detail: Cabinet cleared a fresh tender for the Rs 25,000 crore Tajpur deep-sea port, declaring the Adani agreement void (around May 2026); in September 2026 the site moved to Dadanpatrabar (over 1,700 acres) owing to land issues.

source.label: The Week, Behind Tajpur port relocation

timeline.title: Nadia land shortlisted under Centre's Bhavya scheme
timeline.detail: State shortlisted 118.5 acres at Dhubulia, Nadia, for an industrial park under the Rs 33,660 crore Bhavya scheme (August 2026).

source.label: Swarajya, West Bengal identifies land in Nadia, Paschim Burdwan for industrial parks under Bhavya scheme
